title: Signature Full State Capture
description: Signature Full State Capture is a portability ability in the Signature Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Captures every panel, node, and setting into one snapshot object. title: Signature Delta Snapshots
description: Signature Delta Snapshots is a portability ability in the Signature Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Stores only what changed since the last snapshot to keep files small. A diff against the previous snapshot is computed; unchanged subtrees are referenced, not copied. It takes previous snapshot and produces delta file. Tunable parameters: reference by hash. Guarantee: deltas always apply cleanly in order. This record is a Signature-authored completion — an original design of the JAH system, clearly labeled Signature, and not presented as a harvested public record.

title: Signature Snapshot Branching
description: Signature Snapshot Branching is a portability ability in the Signature Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Branches a snapshot so experiments never touch the original. Guarantee: the parent snapshot is never mutated. title: Signature Encrypted Snapshots
description: Signature Encrypted Snapshots is a portability ability in the Signature Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Encrypts snapshots with a passphrase before they leave the device. AES-256-GCM encrypts the payload; the key is derived from the passphrase with 100k PBKDF2 rounds. It takes passphrase and produces encrypted .jws. Tunable parameters: AES-256-GCM. Guarantee: wrong passphrases always fail loudly.
